title: Crispy Solo Fry Bites
description: A delicious and crispy potato snack, perfect for munching on the go.
instructions: Preheat oil to 350°F (175°C) in a deep fryer or large pot.
Peel and chop the russet potato into 1-inch cubes.
Heat the oil and carefully add the potato cubes in batches to avoid overcrowding.
Fry for 3-4 minutes, or until golden brown, and drain on paper towels.
Mash the solo potatoes with a fork to create a chunky texture.
Serve the crispy potato bites with a dollop of mashed solo potato on top, garnished with chopped nutty.
